after.rosterkit/notices.py:
"""Plain text absence notices for parents."""

from typing import Iterable

from rosterkit.models import Mark, Student
from rosterkit.attendance import days_missed

# ---
def absence_notice(
    student: Student, marks: Iterable[Mark]
) -> str:
    """Short notice naming the student and the days missed.

    Raises ValueError when a mark belongs to someone else or
    when the marks hold no absences.
    """
    own = list(marks)
    for mark in own:
        if mark.student_id != student.student_id:
            raise ValueError(
                f"mark for {mark.student_id!r} does not "
                f"belong to {student.student_id!r}"
            )
    days = days_missed(own)
    if not days:
        raise ValueError(
            f"no absences for {student.student_id!r}"
        )
    name = f"{student.first_name} {student.last_name}"
    count = len(days)
    unit = "day" if count == 1 else "days"
    dates = ", ".join(day.isoformat() for day in days)
    return (
        f"Dear parent or guardian,\n\n"
        f"{name} missed {count} {unit} of class.\n"
        f"Dates absent: {dates}"
    )
after.tests/test_notices.py:
import unittest

from rosterkit.notices import absence_notice
from rosterkit.models import Mark, Student
from datetime import date

STUDENT = Student("7", "Rivera", "Ana", "A")


def mark(day, status="absent", student_id="7"):
    return Mark(student_id, day, status)


class NoticeTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_names_student_count_and_ordered_dates(self):
        marks = [
            mark(date(2026, 3, 5)),
            mark(date(2026, 3, 2)),
            mark(date(2026, 3, 3), "present")
        ]
        text = absence_notice(STUDENT, marks)
        self.assertIn("Ana Rivera", text)
        self.assertIn("2 days", text)
        self.assertIn("2026-03-02, 2026-03-05", text)

    def test_single_day_is_singular(self):
        text = absence_notice(
            STUDENT, [mark(date(2026, 3, 2))]
        )
        self.assertIn("1 day ", text)

    def test_excused_days_are_left_out(self):
        marks = [
            mark(date(2026, 3, 2)),
            mark(date(2026, 3, 3), "excused")
        ]
        text = absence_notice(STUDENT, marks)
        self.assertNotIn("2026-03-03", text)

    def test_foreign_mark_raises(self):
        marks = [
            mark(date(2026, 3, 2)),
            mark(date(2026, 3, 3), student_id="8")
        ]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            absence_notice(STUDENT, marks)

    def test_no_absences_raises(self):
        marks = [mark(date(2026, 3, 2), "present")]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            absence_notice(STUDENT, marks)

    def test_no_marks_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            absence_notice(STUDENT, [])
